rationale.consistency: Flag names mirror zoekt-git-index and files follow cmd/zoekt-* layout, but flock via x/sys/unix ships without a build tag unlike the repo's platform-split files, and it bypasses gitindex.FindGitRepos for its own walker.
rationale.edge_cases: Handles root-as-repo, bare repos, .git files, cross-root duplicates and a missing index dir; misses -delta (parsed, never used), -incremental=false still skips up-to-date repos, and a zoekt.name git config overrides the discovery name so list/prune can disagree.
rationale.scope: Delivers the command, subcommands, lock and name preservation; the indexGitRepo split into prepareRepositoryDescription/IsUpToDate is larger than the minimal shared change, and the delta field is dead.
rationale.readability: Clear file split and names; runSync is long but linear. Minor warts: shadowed var err blocks, duplicated closer.Close() on error paths, the printGeneralHelp flagset re-output trick.
rationale.robustness: Stale detection by Source string equality can delete a freshly rewritten same-name shard when the path differs (e.g. .git vs worktree path); one unreadable subdir or one bad repo aborts the whole sync; metadata read errors are silently dropped.
rationale.maintainability: Good separation into discover/inventory/lock; but IsUpToDate re-opens and re-resolves branches before IndexGitRepo does it again, and prune logic is coupled to exact Source paths, which will be brittle across tools.
